elaine: Heads up 1: final prelaunch list for the webinar + 3 launch posts. Need: prioritized KW list, minimal JSON-LD (Event + Speaker), internal linking plan (pillar -> webinar) and simple redirect rules. Who owns each?

zoe: Ill own KW prioritization and anchor text suggestions. Pushing a trimmed sheet: https://tiny.example/kw-3950 (top 6 intents: awareness -> purchase).

tom: I can do redirects + smoke tests. Reminder: preserve UTM strings. Proposed nginx examples below.

seo-bot: quick-scan: 5 pages missing Event structured data, 2 duplicate meta titles. Full scan: https://tiny.example/scan3950

ginger: I'll drop the JSON-LD and FAQ (max 2) into the landing branch and add a unit test to assert presence. Also will add Speaker schema.

zoe: Anchor plan: 3 contextual links from pillar article -> /webinars/serving-llms (anchors: "inference latency", "production LLM serving", "cost per token"). Also 1 link from /docs/serving. Add UTMs: ?utm_source=article&utm_campaign=serving_launch.

tom: nginx rules (examples):
```
# keep query strings
rewrite ^/blog/2026/(.*)-webinar$ /webinars/serving-llms?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=serving_launch permanent;
location = /resources/webinar { return 301 /webinars/serving-llms; }
```

ginger: JSON-LD (drop-in):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Webinar: Serving LLMs at Scale","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-03-26T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/serving-llms","performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Leo Park","sameAs":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/leo-park"}},"@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Who should attend?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Platform and ML engineers building inference systems."}}]}]}
```

elaine: Nice. Tom 1, include smoke tests in PR: curl -I checks for 301, verify rel=canonical header, sanity-check GA events for register CTA. Also add rollback steps.

tom: Will open PR and request eng-infra window. Canary rollout first.

zoe: Messaging iteration: two hero CTAs to A/B: 1) "Register: See predictable LLM latency in production" 2) "Register: Reduce per-token cost without sacrificing accuracy". I'll add alt microcopy for meta (~155 chars) in the sheet.

seo-bot: recommendation: put rel="canonical" on any older pages to new landing and limit FAQ markup to 1-2 Qs. Consider adding Event status (EventCancelled/EventScheduled) if changes occur.

elaine: Timeline: redirects PR by 15:30, schema + unit tests by 16:30, KW + anchors locked by 17:00, messaging by 18:00, QA pass 20:00. Go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Any blockers?
